name: Release v1.2.1
body:
## Summary

**Bug Fix**: Gray text in broke UI was barely readable - now black/dark gray.

**Features**:
- Added clickable `/broke` command buttons to the status badge overlay (9 commands)
- Modernized UI design with card layouts and better spacing

**Changes**:
- `StatusBadge.jsx`: Full redesign - badge + overlay with black text, Quick Commands section
- `ConfigComponent.jsx`: All secondary text changed from gray to dark gray

**Verification**:
- All 199+ tests pass ✅
- UI validation passes (`npm run validate:ui`) ✅
